info.name: Behemot API
info.description: Log in using POST /auth/login. Postman must retain and send the behemot-api-sid session cookie using its cookie jar. The API does not accept Bearer tokens. Set resource ID variables before using dependent requests. Product listing placeholders such as {{customName}} are literal template syntax; leave those Postman variables undefined.

    "descriptionTemplate": "{{customName}}. Dimensions: {{length}} x {{width}} cm. Warehouse location: {{warehouseLocation}}.",
    "departmentId": "{{departmentId}}"
}
